blurb: My name is Zaide. I’m a born and raised Sitkan and grew up loving horses. I got my first horse at age 17 and shortly thereafter attended Meredith Manor Equestrian School where I trained in teaching, jumping, and dressage. I've also spent many summers as a camp counselor in Whitehorse, Canada at Heart Bar Ranch. For the last 10 years I’ve been providing lessons for youth in Sitka. I enjoy giving others an opportunity
